newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM unit gets savings bank licence.
newsitem.headline: RFM unit gets savings bank licence.

text.p: Food and beverage firm RFM Corp said on Monday the Central Bank had given a savings bank licence to its subsidiary RFM Equities Inc.
The bank, which used to a be a rural bank, will have an authorised capital stock of 500 million pesos, the company said in a statement.
Bank president Alfonso Zamora said the bank would cater to small and medium enterprises (SME), which include RFM's suppliers, dealers, and contract growers.
"We will be focusing on a particular market niche -- the SMEs which are our business partners," Zamora said.
The bank is planning to open 20 branches in the next two years.
